topic: Analytics formula deployment and data requests
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on deploying an analytics frequency formula from staging to production for specific companies (7600 and 7847). The deployment required setting signal calibration for the Mall category (78) and City category (89).

Later, a request was made to re-aggregate all related data for the entire year of 2023. Multiple links were shared demonstrating analytics dashboards for mall performance comparison between staging and actual test data.
decisions: The frequency formula will be deployed from stage to production for companies 7600 and 7847.
Signal calibration must be applied for the Mall category (78) and City category (89).
action_items: Complete re-aggregation of all data for the full year of 2023.
